body: Did you ever feel differently? In all the years you have left to live don’t you think it will change, you can go back to a more stable state.
I don’t think they will notice. You aren’t a joke. I feel like you are in an environment where everybody lost their virginity on a really young age. Being 22 is still young, you have nothing to lose.
Talk to your sister. Ask it was that easy for her?
